instructions.name: initialize_mint
instructions.title: Initialize mint
instructions.rationale: Initializes a freshly allocated mint account; cannot touch existing balances or authorities.
instructions.notes: Setup only: sets decimals (offset 1), mint authority (offset 2) and optional freeze authority (COption at offset 34) on an uninitialized account. Source docs say it MUST share a transaction with the System create_account that allocates the mint, or another party can take the uninitialized account. Needs the Rent sysvar account (see initialize_mint2). Classed read_only per SCHEMA: no effect on existing owner funds.

instructions.name: initialize_account
instructions.title: Initialize token account
instructions.rationale: Initializes a freshly allocated token account and assigns its owner; cannot touch existing balances.
instructions.notes: Setup only. Accounts: account, mint, owner (account index 2), Rent sysvar; no instruction data. Source docs say it MUST share a transaction with the System create_account that allocates the account. For the native mint the token balance becomes the SOL already in the account, so the chosen owner controls that SOL; cap the System create_account or transfer that funds it. Classed read_only per SCHEMA: no effect on existing owner funds.

instructions.name: initialize_multisig
instructions.title: Initialize multisig
instructions.rationale: Initializes a freshly allocated multisig account with N signers and threshold m; changes no existing authority.
instructions.notes: Setup only. m (u8) at offset 1; accounts: multisig, Rent sysvar, then N signer accounts (1 to 11). Source docs say it MUST share a transaction with the System create_account that allocates the account. A multisig has power only once it is used as an owner or authority, either at initialization or later via set_authority (denied by default).

instructions.name: transfer
instructions.title: Transfer
instructions.rationale: Moves tokens from an owner- or delegate-controlled account to a destination account chosen by the caller.
instructions.notes: Amount is the u64le directly after the tag. A delegate may sign up to its delegated amount. For the native mint (wrapped SOL) the matching lamports move too. Accounts: source, destination, authority. See transfer_checked, which also pins mint and decimals.

instructions.name: approve
instructions.title: Approve delegate
instructions.rationale: Grants a delegate spending rights over the source account up to an amount, replacing any existing delegate.
instructions.notes: The amount is the delegated allowance cap, not a transfer: the delegate can later transfer or burn up to it without further owner signatures. The descriptor lets tools cap the allowance. Accounts: source, delegate, owner.

instructions.name: revoke
instructions.title: Revoke delegate
instructions.rationale: Clears the account delegate and delegated amount; removes rather than grants authority.
instructions.notes: No instruction data. Safe direction (the owner or the delegate itself may sign), but it edits delegation state so it is classed authority_change and denied by default.

instructions.name: set_authority
instructions.title: Set authority
instructions.rationale: Reassigns or removes a mint authority, freeze authority, token-account owner or close authority.
instructions.notes: authority_type u8 at offset 1 (0 MintTokens, 1 FreezeAccount, 2 AccountOwner, 3 CloseAccount), then new_authority as COption<Pubkey> at offset 2 (flag byte, then 32 bytes). AccountOwner hands the whole token account to the new authority; removing a mint or freeze authority is irreversible. Accounts: mint or token account, current authority.

instructions.name: mint_to
instructions.title: Mint to
instructions.rationale: Issuer power: mints new tokens to any token account, inflating supply; requires the mint authority.
instructions.notes: Creates supply rather than debiting an account, so it matters only when the mandate owner is the mint authority. The native mint cannot be minted. Accounts: mint, destination, mint authority.

instructions.name: burn
instructions.title: Burn
instructions.rationale: Destroys tokens from an owner- or delegate-controlled account; irreversible loss bounded by the amount.
instructions.notes: A delegate may burn up to its delegated amount. Native-mint (wrapped SOL) accounts are not supported; use close_account. Accounts: source, mint, authority.

instructions.name: close_account
instructions.title: Close token account
instructions.rationale: Closes a token account and sends all its lamports to a destination account chosen by the signer.
instructions.notes: No instruction data. Non-native accounts must hold zero tokens. For native (wrapped SOL) accounts the entire balance, wrapped SOL included, goes to the destination. If a close authority is set it must sign instead of the owner. Accounts: account, destination, authority.

instructions.name: freeze_account
instructions.title: Freeze account
instructions.rationale: Freezes a token account so its owner cannot move tokens; requires the mint's freeze authority.
instructions.notes: No instruction data. Mint-level administrative power over other holders' accounts; not supported on native (wrapped SOL) accounts. Accounts: account, mint, freeze authority.

instructions.name: thaw_account
instructions.title: Thaw account
instructions.rationale: Unfreezes a frozen token account; requires the mint's freeze authority.
instructions.notes: No instruction data. Mirror of freeze_account: restores the owner's ability to move tokens. Accounts: account, mint, freeze authority.

instructions.name: transfer_checked
instructions.title: Transfer (checked)
instructions.rationale: Moves tokens like transfer but also verifies mint and decimals; destination chosen by the caller.
instructions.notes: Layout: tag, amount u64le at offset 1, decimals u8 at offset 9; the program rejects a decimals value that differs from the mint. Same authority rules as transfer (a delegate may sign up to its delegated amount). Accounts: source, mint, destination, authority.

instructions.name: approve_checked
instructions.title: Approve delegate (checked)
instructions.rationale: Grants a delegate spending rights up to an amount, with mint and decimals verified.
instructions.notes: Layout: tag, amount u64le at offset 1, decimals u8 at offset 9. The amount is the delegated allowance cap, not a transfer. Accounts: source, mint, delegate, owner.

instructions.name: mint_to_checked
instructions.title: Mint to (checked)
instructions.rationale: Issuer power: mints new tokens to any token account, inflating supply; requires the mint authority.
instructions.notes: Layout: tag, amount u64le at offset 1, decimals u8 at offset 9. Accounts: mint, destination, mint authority.

instructions.name: burn_checked
instructions.title: Burn (checked)
instructions.rationale: Destroys tokens like burn with decimals verified; irreversible loss bounded by the amount.
instructions.notes: Layout: tag, amount u64le at offset 1, decimals u8 at offset 9. Native-mint accounts are not supported. Accounts: source, mint, authority.

instructions.name: initialize_account2
instructions.title: Initialize token account (v2)
instructions.rationale: Initializes a freshly allocated token account with the owner passed in data; cannot touch existing balances.
instructions.notes: Setup only. Owner pubkey is the 32 bytes at offset 1. Accounts: account, mint, Rent sysvar. For the native mint the token balance becomes the SOL already in the account, so the chosen owner controls that SOL; cap the System create_account or transfer that funds it. Classed read_only per SCHEMA: no effect on existing owner funds.

instructions.name: sync_native
instructions.title: Sync native (wrapped SOL)
instructions.rationale: Re-syncs a wrapped-SOL token account's amount to its lamports; needs no signer and moves no funds.
instructions.notes: No instruction data. Credits lamports sent to a native token account (for example by a System transfer) to its token amount. The deployed p-token recomputes amount as lamports minus the rent reserve, so it can also lower it. An optional Rent sysvar account may follow.

instructions.name: initialize_account3
instructions.title: Initialize token account (v3)
instructions.rationale: Initializes a freshly allocated token account with owner in data and no Rent sysvar; cannot touch existing balances.
instructions.notes: Setup only. Owner pubkey is the 32 bytes at offset 1. Accounts: account, mint. For the native mint the token balance becomes the SOL already in the account, so the chosen owner controls that SOL; cap the System create_account or transfer that funds it. Classed read_only per SCHEMA: no effect on existing owner funds.

instructions.name: initialize_multisig2
instructions.title: Initialize multisig (v2)
instructions.rationale: Initializes a freshly allocated multisig account without the Rent sysvar; changes no existing authority.
instructions.notes: Setup only. m (u8) at offset 1; accounts: multisig, then N signer accounts (1 to 11).

instructions.name: initialize_mint2
instructions.title: Initialize mint (v2)
instructions.rationale: Initializes a freshly allocated mint account without the Rent sysvar; cannot touch existing balances.
instructions.notes: Setup only: decimals u8 at offset 1, mint authority pubkey at offset 2, freeze authority COption<Pubkey> at offset 34. Accounts: mint. Classed read_only per SCHEMA: no effect on existing owner funds.

instructions.name: get_account_data_size
instructions.title: Get account data size
instructions.rationale: Returns the token-account size for a mint through return data; writes no account state.
instructions.notes: Query only: result is a little-endian u64 in return data. The interface source says the program ignores any instruction data. Accounts: mint.

instructions.name: initialize_immutable_owner
instructions.title: Initialize immutable owner
instructions.rationale: No-op apart from checking the account is uninitialized; kept for Associated Token Account compatibility.
instructions.notes: The source documents this as a no-op in this program, included for compatibility with the Associated Token Account program; it only fails if the account is already initialized. Accounts: token account.

instructions.name: amount_to_ui_amount
instructions.title: Amount to UI amount
instructions.rationale: Converts a raw amount to a UI string through return data; moves no value.
instructions.notes: Query only. The u64le at offset 1 is a conversion input, not a spend, so no amount descriptor is given on purpose. Accounts: mint.

instructions.name: ui_amount_to_amount
instructions.title: UI amount to amount
instructions.rationale: Converts a UI amount string to a raw amount through return data; moves no value.
instructions.notes: Query only. The UTF-8 string after the tag is a conversion input, not a spend. Accounts: mint.

instructions.name: withdraw_excess_lamports
instructions.title: Withdraw excess lamports
instructions.rationale: Sends lamports above the rent-exempt reserve out of a mint, token account or multisig to a destination chosen by the caller.
instructions.notes: Not implemented by the reference spl-token program crate (v9.0.0); added by p-token under SIMD-0266 with tag 38, as in Token-2022. Live on mainnet-beta since epoch 971 (2026-05-13) and devnet since epoch 1044 (2026-03-25); the classic build rejects it. No instruction data, so no amount can be capped: the whole surplus above the rent-exempt minimum moves. Authority: token-account owner, mint authority, or the multisig itself; native (wrapped SOL) accounts are rejected. Denied by default because it cannot be amount-limited. Accounts: source, destination, authority.

instructions.name: unwrap_lamports
instructions.title: Unwrap lamports
instructions.rationale: Moves lamports out of a native (wrapped SOL) token account to any destination account chosen by the caller.
instructions.notes: Not implemented by the reference spl-token program crate (v9.0.0); added by p-token under SIMD-0266 with tag 45, as in Token-2022. Live on mainnet-beta since epoch 971 (2026-05-13) and devnet since epoch 1044 (2026-03-25); the classic build rejects it. Data is COption<u64>: option flag u8 at offset 1, then the u64le amount at offset 2 ONLY when the flag is 1. Flag 0 unwraps the ENTIRE balance and the program ignores any trailing bytes, so a reader that trusts offset 2 without checking byte 1 == 1 can be bypassed; treat flag 0 as unbounded. The source must be a native token account; a delegate is limited to its delegated amount. Denied by default for this reason. Accounts: source, destination, authority.

instructions.name: batch
instructions.title: Batch
instructions.rationale: Runs a sequence of inner Token instructions, including transfers, approvals and authority changes, hiding them from a per-instruction allowlist.
instructions.notes: Not implemented by the reference spl-token program crate (v9.0.0); added by p-token under SIMD-0266 with tag 255. Live on mainnet-beta since epoch 971 (2026-05-13) and devnet since epoch 1044 (2026-03-25); the classic build rejects it. After the tag the data repeats [num_accounts u8][data_len u8][inner tag + args]; each inner instruction takes consecutive accounts from the outer list and is authorized by the outer signers, and batch cannot nest. A per-instruction allowlist or amount limit cannot see inside, so allowing batch effectively allows every inner Token instruction including set_authority and close_account. Classed other with defaultDeny: it has no single risk class and its risk is the union of the inner instructions.
